fact: The DGCP list of numbered contracts for 2025, extracted on 30 December 2025 from SIGCP-GB, reports 68 contracts with a total value of FCFA 8,375,453,235.
title: Lista dos contratos numerados junto da DGCP, Orçamento anual 2025
